journeys.name: search-models-in-popover

journeys.title: Choose a local model
journeys.description: Switch the picker to local models and select the Ollama model for this thread.

journeys.name: filter-models-by-capability
journeys.title: Filter models by capability
journeys.description: Toggle a capability filter in the model picker and keep the popover open.

journeys.name: set-thinking-effort
journeys.title: Set the thinking effort
journeys.description: Change the reasoning effort selector in the composer meta bar.

journeys.name: command-palette-find-thread
journeys.title: Find a thread through the command palette
journeys.description: Open the palette with the keyboard, search for a thread, and open it.

journeys.name: command-palette-new-conversation
journeys.title: New conversation from the palette
journeys.description: The palette action creates a thread and leaves the composer idle.

journeys.name: command-palette-open-settings
journeys.title: Open settings from the palette
journeys.description: The palette action opens the settings menu.

journeys.name: browse-workspace-files-in-dock
journeys.title: Browse workspace files in the dock
journeys.description: Open the file explorer from the palette, enter a folder, and go back up.

journeys.name: open-task-center-and-close-it
journeys.title: Open the task center and close the dock cell
journeys.description: The task center lists the seeded image job; closing its cell returns to the plain workspace.

journeys.name: collapse-a-dock-cell
journeys.title: Collapse and expand the dock
journeys.description: Open the explorer in the dock, collapse it to the rail, and expand it again.

journeys.name: open-settings-and-switch-theme
journeys.title: Open settings and switch the color mode
journeys.description: Reach Settings through the sidebar control and select the Light theme.

journeys.name: theme-persists-across-reload
journeys.title: Theme choice survives a reload
journeys.description: Pick the light theme, reload with storage kept straight into the settings route, and find the theme control still there.

journeys.name: light-theme-preselected
journeys.title: Start from the light theme
journeys.description: The light-theme scenario opens with Light already selected in settings.

journeys.name: open-model-provider-settings
journeys.title: Reach provider configuration from the app menu
journeys.description: Open the menu, select Models, and verify the web-search provider card renders.

journeys.name: replace-openrouter-key
journeys.title: Remove and re-add the OpenRouter key
journeys.description: Remove the stored key, enter a placeholder, connect, and see it stored again.

journeys.name: set-ollama-endpoint
journeys.title: Set the Ollama endpoint
journeys.description: Enter the local Ollama URL under Models and commit it.

journeys.name: open-agent-memory-settings
journeys.title: Reach agent instructions and memory settings
journeys.description: Open the menu, select Agent, and verify the persistent-instructions editor renders.

journeys.name: add-an-agent-memory-fact
journeys.title: Add a memory fact
journeys.description: Type a new fact under Agent, add it, and see a third editable fact appear.

journeys.description: The keyboard shortcut opens the palette in the browser build.

journeys.name: code-block-toolbar
journeys.title: Use the code block toolbar
journeys.description: On a reply carrying an HTML document, toggle line numbers and wrapping, copy the block, then switch the block to its preview view.

journeys.name: code-block-open-and-download
journeys.title: Open and download a code block
journeys.description: Open hands the HTML document to a new browser tab and Download saves it; neither leaves the thread.

journeys.title: View an HTML artifact full screen
journeys.description: The inline artifact card enables View once the bridge has read the file; the full-screen viewer offers Open in OS and Close.

journeys.description: Open in dock renders the HTML file in a dock file viewer with an inline preview; Open in OS is a no-op against the mocked bridge.

journeys.description: The artifact registry lists a landing page; opening it from the palette shows the dock artifact panel with source toggle, open and download.

journeys.name: markdown-links-open-workspace-path
journeys.title: Follow a workspace path link
journeys.description: A workspace path in a reply hands the file to the OS through the bridge; an external link is hovered but never followed.

journeys.name: message-copy-from-hover-actions
journeys.title: Copy a message from its hover actions
journeys.description: Hovering a message reveals its action row; Copy puts the text on the clipboard.

journeys.name: long-thread-show-earlier
journeys.title: Reveal earlier messages in a long thread
journeys.description: Past one page the transcript collapses its head behind a Show control; clicking it renders the earliest turns.

journeys.name: long-thread-jump-to-latest
journeys.title: Jump back to the latest message
journeys.description: Scrolling up a long transcript shows Jump to latest; clicking it returns to the newest turn and hides the control.

journeys.name: regenerate-confirm-and-cancel
journeys.title: Regenerate mid-thread asks first
journeys.description: Regenerating an answer that is not the last one shows a confirm panel; Cancel keeps the thread as it was.

journeys.description: Editing an earlier question opens the edit panel; Save asks to confirm because later turns would be dropped, and both cancels back out.

journeys.name: grouped-activity-timeline
journeys.title: Expand a grouped activity timeline
journeys.description: Consecutive tool calls fold into one group; the group control expands and collapses them.

journeys.name: memory-sources-open-and-unavailable
journeys.title: Inspect every kind of memory source
journeys.description: A reply grounded in a message, a vanished message and a library file: each chip opens its detail, and the vanished one is marked unavailable.

journeys.name: memory-source-open-thread
journeys.title: Open the thread a memory came from
journeys.description: Open source on a message chip navigates to the conversation that holds it.

journeys.name: attachment-thumbnail-open
journeys.title: Open a message attachment
journeys.description: A message attachment thumbnail hands the file to the OS through the bridge; the markdown attachment is listed by name.

journeys.name: image-lightbox-navigation
journeys.title: Browse rendered images in the lightbox
journeys.description: A finished two-image job opens in the lightbox with next and previous, the full prompt, copy and open in OS.

journeys.name: image-job-retry-failed-and-cancelled

journeys.description: Failed and cancelled image jobs keep Retry; Copy error copies the failure and a retried job can be cancelled while it is still pending.

journeys.name: activity-rows-toggle
journeys.title: Expand image activity rows
journeys.description: Each image job row on the thread can be expanded and collapsed.

journeys.name: aurora-activity-stream-diff
journeys.title: Open the Aurora activity stream and a diff
journeys.description: In the Aurora pack the reply folds its work behind chips; expanding shows the work note and the edit call with its diff card.

journeys.name: aurora-fine-tune-render
journeys.title: Fine-tune an Aurora image render
journeys.description: The cover render exposes a fine-tune card: adjust images, size and seed, reset, then render again.

journeys.name: aurora-reply-footer
journeys.title: Use the Aurora reply footer
journeys.description: The suggested follow-up sends as the next message; the source chip then opens the Agent tab of the menu, where recall sources live.

steps.value: Want me to run the full suite next?

journeys.description: Three pending prompts: pick an option, write a free answer and send it, and skip the last.

journeys.name: prompt-cards-skip-and-option
journeys.title: Skip a prompt and pick an option
journeys.description: Skip the approval prompt outright and answer the recommendation with one of its options.

journeys.name: command-palette-empty-and-backdrop
journeys.title: Palette empty state and backdrop
journeys.description: A query nothing matches shows the empty row; clicking the backdrop closes the palette.

journeys.name: aurora-command-palette-empty
journeys.title: Aurora palette names what it searched
journeys.description: In the Aurora pack, a query that matches nothing shows the empty state that names the query, and the backdrop closes the palette.

journeys.name: update-pill-install-and-dismiss

journeys.description: With an update staged the pill offers install; dismiss hides the notice.

journeys.name: attachment-tray-and-notice
journeys.title: Manage a drafted attachment tray
journeys.description: Two staged attachments can be handed to the OS and removed; the persistence notice above the draft can be dismissed.

journeys.name: persistence-notice-reload
journeys.title: Reload from the persistence notice
journeys.description: The conflict notice's Reload action reloads the app and the workspace comes back.

journeys.name: first-run-local-ready-continue
journeys.title: Continue with a detected local model
journeys.description: Ollama has models: the local card offers to continue with the selected one, and the sidebar hint points at the menu.

journeys.name: first-run-menu-hint

journeys.description: The one-time hint on the brand mark opens the menu.

journeys.name: first-run-local-empty-starter-pull

journeys.description: Ollama runs with no models: the primary action pulls a starter and the secondary opens Local settings.

journeys.description: Ollama is installed but stopped: Check again re-polls and Open Local settings goes to the models tab.

journeys.name: first-run-install-ollama

journeys.description: No Ollama found: Check again re-runs detection and the primary action opens Local settings.

journeys.name: local-embed-pull-cancel-dismiss

journeys.description: The semantic-memory nudge pulls nomic-embed-text; the pull can be cancelled and the nudge dismissed.

journeys.title: Install the embedding model from Agent settings
journeys.description: With the embedding model missing, Agent settings offers Install; clicking it starts the pull and turns into Cancel.

journeys.name: banner-ollama-offline

journeys.description: A local model is selected but Ollama is unreachable: the composer banner opens Local settings.

journeys.name: banner-local-image-offline

journeys.description: A direct image model is selected but ComfyUI is stopped: the banner opens local settings.

journeys.name: banner-no-model-open-models
journeys.title: No model banner
journeys.description: Nothing configured after Look around: the composer banner opens the models tab.

journeys.name: task-center-cancel-and-retry
journeys.title: Cancel and retry from the task center
journeys.description: The task ledger lists an agent task and two image jobs; cancel the task and retry both jobs.

journeys.name: task-center-empty
journeys.title: Task center with nothing running
journeys.description: A bare desktop shows the empty task ledger.

journeys.name: agent-recall-sources
journeys.title: Curate recall sources
journeys.description: Expand the message group, search it, exclude a thread, re-include all, and toggle a whole source type.

journeys.name: agent-library-and-index
journeys.title: Library sources and the semantic index
journeys.description: Toggle the seeded library file, refresh the library, and rebuild the index while the danger controls stay visible.

journeys.name: agent-facts-edit-and-clear
journeys.title: Edit, cancel, delete and clear facts
journeys.description: Facts can be edited in place, the edit cancelled, one deleted, and the rest cleared after confirmation.

journeys.name: preferences-toggles-and-shortcut
journeys.title: Preferences toggles and the summon chord
journeys.description: Flip a preference toggle, record a new summon chord and reset it, switch global summon off (the recorder disables) and back on, and toggle close-to-tray.

journeys.name: preferences-export-and-import-modes

journeys.description: Export writes a JSON file; Replace mode demands the confirmation phrase before the import button enables.

journeys.name: preferences-danger-zone
journeys.title: Danger zone confirm and cancel
journeys.description: Each delete asks to confirm; cancel one and run another.

journeys.name: models-catalog-refresh-and-clear
journeys.title: Refresh and clear the OpenRouter catalog
journeys.description: Load models pulls the mocked catalog; Clear drops it. The stored key can be revealed, and Get key is only hovered.

journeys.name: dock-two-cells-swap-and-resize

journeys.description: Opening a file beside the explorer fills the second cell; swap exchanges them and the resize handles are hoverable.

journeys.name: dock-explorer-crumbs-and-refresh
journeys.title: Breadcrumbs and refresh in the explorer
journeys.description: Descend into a folder, climb back through the breadcrumb and the parent control, and refresh the listing.

journeys.name: dock-media-viewers

journeys.description: Audio plays inline, a still image renders, and unreadable media shows its error notices.

journeys.description: A JSON file renders as collapsible keys, a text file as plain text, and an unreadable file as a notice, and a markdown note renders as markdown.

journeys.name: skill-picker-choose-and-clear
journeys.title: Pick a workspace skill and clear it
journeys.description: The skill control opens a picker; choose Research, then clear back to none.

journeys.name: favorite-a-model

journeys.name: local-context-mode

journeys.description: With a local model selected the composer offers a context mode; pick bare prompt.

journeys.description: Clicking the brand mark opens the menu; the settings dot re-polls the bridge.

journeys.name: whats-new-dismiss

journeys.description: The close control on the welcome panel dismisses it without Got it.

journeys.name: mobile-open-sidebar-and-menu

journeys.description: On a phone the top bar opens the sidebar; from it the menu opens and the back control returns to the chat.

journeys.name: mobile-sidebar-close-controls

journeys.description: The title opens the sidebar, the close control shuts it, the backdrop shuts it, and the hamburger opens it again.

journeys.name: mobile-new-conversation-and-copy-link

journeys.description: The top bar starts a new conversation and copies the thread link.

journeys.name: web-lite-download-cue

journeys.description: An empty conversation in Web Lite shows the desktop download cue; the link is hovered, never followed.
